name: Vamier Mansion
source:
You wake up one night on a dark, quiet street alone. What’s more, you realize you have somehow lost your memories. While trying all your might to remember anything, a stranger appears and offers you a place to stay. What will you do from then on?

[From [url=https://delusional-devi.itch.io/vamier-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，你在一条黑暗、安静的街道上独自醒来。更重要的是，你意识到你已经失去了记忆。当你竭尽全力回忆任何事情时，一个陌生人出现并为你提供了一个住宿的地方。从那时起你会做什么？

[来自[url=https://delusional-devi.itch.io/vamier-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
